title: kura — suite overview
description: Status-first overview of the kura suite (gateway, library-manager, release-indexer). Metric references: services/library-manager/docs/metrics.md, services/release-indexer/docs/metrics.md, and the gateway's kura_mcp_* set (AGENTS.md gateway section). Uses a Prometheus datasource variable named 'datasource'.

list.name: index rebuilding
list.textFormat: kura_library_index_rebuilding = 1 — cold rebuilds answer 503 server_not_ready on /api/v1/*

list.name: upstream unhealthy
list.textFormat: gateway answers 502 backend_unavailable for this leaf

panels.title: Series breakdown
panels.description: kura_library_series_status is a partition of the index; resolution/source count a series once per distinct value, so those groups can sum past the series total.

panels.title: Non-ok responses
panels.description: Headline is gateway-observed (5xx + 4xx). The ↳ rows are the same requests one hop down — do not add them to the total.

panels.title: Lifetime match status
panels.description: kura_indexer_queue_items includes terminal states, so this is the lifetime catalog disposition, NOT current queue depth (that is section 2, which excludes matched).

panels.title: Matcher confidence — cumulative buckets
panels.description: Prometheus histogram buckets are cumulative: each bar counts submissions with confidence <= le.

panels.title: Episodes by state
panels.description: kura_library_episodes partitions non-special trackable episodes: present includes files with a staged upgrade; pending_apply is staged-with-no-active; specials are excluded (see kura_library_series_staged for all pending reconcile work).

panels.title: 1 · Incident triage — which component, when, why
library 5xx
panels.description: 503 server_not_ready is expected exactly while kura_library_index_rebuilding = 1.

panels.title: Readiness & upstream state
panels.description: index_rebuilding = 1 is the cause view of library 503s. *_stats_scrape_ok = 0 means the queue/catalog gauges are last-known-good, not live.

panels.title: Scrape health
panels.description: When up == 0 every other panel on this dashboard is flatlining, not healthy.

panels.title: Index rebuild duration
panels.description: Average duration of rebuilds completing in each interval. Only cold rebuilds (empty index) are 503 windows; the hourly warm rebuild serves normally throughout.

panels.title: MCP bridge by tool
panels.description: kura_mcp_* from the bridge's :9091 exporter — caddy_* sees the HTTP hop but not which tool an agent broke on.

panels.title: Queue items by state
panels.description: matched is excluded — it is two orders of magnitude larger and would flatten everything else. Lifetime match status lives in row 0.

panels.title: exhausted releases
panels.description: A rising exhausted count means the matcher is systematically failing on some releases. See 'Why matches fail'.

panels.title: Why matches fail
panels.description: kura_indexer_submit_unmatched_reasons_total: no_candidate | ambiguous | parse_failure | low_confidence | none (matcher sent no reason) | other (unrecognized free text). parse_failure is your bug; no_candidate means the series is not in the library yet.

panels.title: stuck leases
panels.description: min_over_time of leased over 15m: anything > 0 means the matcher claimed work and never came back (n8n workflow died mid-run).

panels.title: claim starvation
panels.description: empty / (claimed + empty). High with a drained queue = idle and healthy. High with claimable rising = the matcher is falling behind.

panels.title: submit non-ok
panels.description: conflict is the idempotency path (replayed submit) — expected. error is not.

panels.title: queue / catalog gauge freshness
panels.description: 0 means the queue and catalog gauges on this dashboard are last-known-good, not live.

panels.title: Time since last successful crawl
panels.description: kura_indexer_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds is absent until a source's first success since boot (and always absent for disabled sources) — No data here means 'no success yet', not 'healthy'.

panels.title: Jobs by kind
panels.description: apply/stage legitimately run minutes on NFS — p95 alone is not a problem signal.

panels.title: Build info
panels.description: All versions should agree after a deploy (single repo-wide version tag).

panels.title: Version skew
panels.description: Distinct version strings across all build_info series. > 1 means a partial deploy.
